content.short: Labyrinth enables privacy-preserving DeFi with private transfers, swaps, and lending under a compliant framework.
content.description: Labyrinth delivers privacy-preserving capabilities without compromising compliance, serving traders, whales, DAOs, institutions, foundations, and retail users. Traditional DeFi often forces a choice between privacy and regulatory visibility, leading to KYC privacy issues. Labyrinth offers a privacy-focused modular framework supported by a decentralized compliance network, enabling private transfers, trading, liquidity provision, lending, staking, and selective disclosure to satisfy compliance needs.
content.meta: Labyrinth provides privacy-preserving DeFi tooling with a compliance network. Discover Labyrinth and other Zero Knowledge Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
